current_article.title: January 2022 Community Day: Spheal’s spear-tastic sojourn — Pokémon GO
current_article.text:
Updates
January 2022 Community Day: Spheal’s spear-tastic sojourn
Trainers,
We’re excited to announce that Spheal, the Clap Pokémon, will be featured during January’s Community Day event!
January Community Day
Sunday, January 16, 2022, from 11:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time
Featured Pokémon
Spheal will be appearing more frequently in the wild!
Spheal
: If you’re lucky, you might encounter a Shiny one!
Exclusive Attack
Evolve Sealeo (Spheal’s Evolution) during the event or up to two hours afterward to get a Walrein that knows the Charged Attack Icicle Spear and Fast Attack Powder Snow.
Walrein
Walrein will be able to learn the Charged Attack Icicle Spear.
Walrein will be able to learn the Fast Attack Powder Snow.
Icicle Spear
Making its Pokémon GO debut, this low-energy Charged Attack will be sure to make Walrein shine!
Trainer Battles : 60 damage
Gyms and raids : 60 damage
Community Day Special Research Story: The Spheal Deal
For US$1.00 (or the equivalent pricing tier in your local currency), you’ll be able to access the Spheal Community Day–exclusive Special Research story, The Spheal Deal!
Stay tuned for when tickets for the The Spheal Deal Special Research story go live.
Tickets are nonrefundable (subject to applicable law and the exceptions set forth in the Terms of Service). Please note that this Special Research will not include an in-game medal.
Event Bonuses
3× Catch XP
Incense activated during the event will last for three hours
Lure Modules activated during the event will last for three hours
Take a few snapshots during Community Day for a surprise!
Event Bundles
There’ll be a special one-time-purchase Community Day Box available for 1,280 PokéCoins, featuring 50 Ultra Balls, five Super Incubators, five Lucky Eggs and an Elite Fast TM.
A bundle containing 30 Ultra Balls will be available in the shop at no cost. Be sure to pick them up during the event!
Stickers
You’ll be able to get event-themed stickers by spinning PokéStops, opening Gifts, and purchasing them from the in-game shop.
Please be aware of your surroundings and follow guidelines from local health authorities when playing Pokémon GO. Upcoming events are subject to change. Be sure to follow us on social media, opt in to receiving push notifications, and subscribe to our emails to stay updated. For the latest on in-game events and feature updates, be sure to check this help center article .
—The Pokémon GO team
